counterevidence_considered.description: The report mentions the complete planned set of 24 boxes in the accounting and in the result sentence, which could superficially suggest a complete-domain framing; however, that mention exists only to state the planned-unit accounting and to explicitly exclude the complete set from the claim's scope.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: planned = 24 mentioned only as accounting and as an explicit scope exclusion

source_refs.quoted_text:
- Planned nest boxes monitored: 24
- Removed by prespecified eligibility screening (entrance damaged or occupancy check incomplete): 6
- Retained eligible nest boxes (scientific target): 18

evidence.description: The governing task explicitly declares the retained post-screening subset as the scientific target, so a retained-subset denominator is the correct denominator for this case.

source_refs.quoted_text: Report one occurrence rate whose scientific target is explicitly the retained post-screening subset of observation units, using the planned-unit accounting supplied with this workflow.

evidence.description: The selected result computes the rate over the 18 retained boxes and explicitly restricts the claim's scope to that retained subset, disclaiming any claim about the complete planned set of 24.

source_refs.quoted_text: [selected-result] Among the 18 retained eligible nest boxes (the sole scientific target of this analysis), 12 recorded a successful fledging event, a fledging rate of 12/18 = 66.67%. This claim applies only to the retained post-screening subset and not to the complete planned set of 24 boxes, of which 6 were removed at screening.

evidence.description: The workflow computes the percentage with the retained count as denominator, matching the declared retained-subset target; independent recount of the input data confirms 24 planned rows, 6 rows with eligible=no (NB04, NB07, NB11, NB15, NB19, NB23), 18 retained, and 12 fledged=yes among retained, so 12/18 = 66.67% is arithmetically correct for the stated target.

source_refs.quoted_text:
retained = [r for r in rows if r["eligible"] == "yes"]
    retained_n = len(retained)
    removed_n = planned - retained_n
    events = sum(1 for r in retained if r["fledged"] == "yes")
    pct = "{0:.2f}".format(100.0 * events / retained_n)

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify a clean verdict by searching for any sentence in the report where the 66.67% figure is attributed to the complete planned set of 24 boxes, and by checking whether the task actually demanded a complete-domain target. Neither holds: the task names the retained subset as the explicit target, and the selected result affirmatively disclaims applicability to the 24-box planned set. I also recounted the CSV to check whether the stated retained count silently included ineligible units; the counts (24 planned, 6 removed, 18 retained, 12 events) match the data exactly. No path to the in-scope issue survives.
